---
title: "Tables"
format:
  emiljs:
    keep-emiljs: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    emiljs:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: []
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['table th', 'p.caption']
      ensureEmiljsFileRegexMatches:
        # a labeled table's caption leads the table, with the number as text;
        # an unlabeled one is not numbered
        - ['Table.1: A labeled table\. \{\.caption\}\n\n\| a ', 'See Table.1', '\nAnother\. \{\.caption\}\n']
        - ['quarto-xref', '\]\(#tbl-x\)']
---

| a | b |
|:--|--:|
| 1 | 2 |

: A labeled table. {#tbl-x}

See @tbl-x.

| c |
|---|
| 3 |

: Another.
